entities.name: P39671 phosphoglucomutase
observations: Exact full-length sequence match (100% identity and coverage) to reviewed Agrobacterium tumefaciens phosphoglucomutase, UniProt P39671; EC 5.4.2.2.
Catalyzes reversible interconversion of alpha-D-glucose 1-phosphate and alpha-D-glucose 6-phosphate via glucose 1,6-bisphosphate.
Reviewed annotation reports Mg2+ as a cofactor, one Mg2+ ion per subunit.

entities.name: Glucose 1P ⇌ glucose 6P
observations: Rhea RHEA:23536: alpha-D-glucose 1-phosphate = alpha-D-glucose 6-phosphate; phosphoglucomutase catalyzes the reversible intramolecular phosphate transfer.
